tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /srid pa'i 'jigs pa las skyobs shing*// rnam grol bgrod pa'i lam gcig pu// lung rtogs gnyis bsdus zhi bsil chos// gus pa'i phyag gi yul du bsten// de yang gangs can bod kyi ljongs su sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba nas brtsams da lta'i bar du/ mkhas btsun bzang grub kyi skyes bu khyad par can bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa rnams kyis rang rang gi nyams myong gi steng nas byung ba'i man ngag sna tshogs pa zhig ma 'ongs pa'i mi rabs rim byung rnams la thugs brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs te/ bstan bcos dang zhal gdams/ zin bris dang*/ cho ga /lo rgyus dang*/ rnam thar sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig rtsom 'bri gnang ste/ bzhugs pa de dag bar lam dus kyi 'gyur ba la brten nas mang po zhig chud zos su phyin pa ni bod phyi nang tsam ma yin par 'dzam gling gi skye 'gro yongs la gyong gun chen po zhig byung ste/ shin tu phangs pa'i gnas su 'gyur par ma zad/ da lta 'gro ba'i bsod nams kyi skal par bzhugs pa dag las kyang*/ kha shas dpe rgyun dkon pas mi mngon pa'i dbyings su phebs la/ nye ba rnams mi nyams par dpe rgyun spel ba'i ched dang*/ yang phyag dpe shin tu mkho gal che ba khag /thos bsam dang nyams len gnang mkhan/ dpal 'byor gyi rgyab rten de tsam med par spros med du bzhugs rgyur thugs mnyes pa rnams kyis stabs bde'i thog nas phyag dpe khag thob pa'i ched/ wā ṇa badzra bidyā dpe mdzod khang gis spar bskrun zhus dang zhu 'char bzhin/ da lam dpal rgyal dbang karma pa gsum pa rang byung rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dbu ma chos dbyings bstod pa'i rnam bshad dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan gyi sa bcad snang byed sgron me gzhung dang bcas pa dang*/ sher phyin skabs brgyad kyi stong thun dang bcas pa'i gzhung 'di nyid/ wā ṇa badzra bidyā dpe mdzod khang nas phyag dpe deb grangs 1000 tham pa spar thengs dang por spar bskrun gnang ba dang*/

de skabs dpe cha zhu bsgrig 'gan khur ba tshe ring dang*/ mdun shog mdzes ris pa karma chos 'phel la sogs pa thams cad kyi phya ra gru 'degs gnang ba la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhes zhu rgyu dang*/ ma 'ongs par phyag dpe gzigs mkhan rnams kyis dpe cha 'di'i steng nas bslab sbyang*/ zhib 'jug nyams len gang gzab kyis rang don du thos bsam sgom gsum/ gzhan don du 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ gnyis don du mkhas btsun bzang gsum ste dam pa'i ngang tshul dgu yis don gnyis lhun gyis grub pa zhig yong ba'i smon 'dun dang*/ de lta bu gnang rogs zhes kyang zhu ba lags/ de bzhin ma phyi gsal po ma thob pa dang*/ zhu dag gnad smin ma song ba sogs kyi lhag chad dang*/ nor 'khrul byung ba thams cad mkhas pa'i dbang po rnams kyi drung du bshags shing*/ nor bcos bka' bslab kyang lhug por stsol gnang bka' drin zhu/ khra 'gu sprul ming pas/
